_notes.why_not_leaf_sum: Summing every detail (leaf) item code would double-count against these subtotal codes, AND silently under-count SG&A: in this workbook's RAW_SYSTEM(EXP), SG&A (51xxxxx) detail line items are all zero - only the 5100000 total itself is populated. So totals here always come from the verified top-level codes, never from summing detail rows.
_notes.TOTAL_EXPENSE: Not a real GL account code - a derived KPI for dashboard use. Excluded from the RAW self-consistency check (core/pnl_engine.check_calculated_accounts_against_raw) since there is no RAW row to compare it to.
